headline: [Big Meeting!] Xi and Putin Talk for [Over 2 Hours] Before Trump Summit
sub: Three-way meeting with Trump set for Thursday
caption:
🚨 BREAKING: Big Meeting! Xi and Putin Talk for Over 2 Hours Before Trump Summit

Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin held talks in Shenzhen, China, on Wednesday, November 18, on the sidelines of the APEC summit. The talks lasted more than two hours, according to Russia's TASS news agency. It comes one day before a planned three-way meeting with US President Donald Trump.

🔹 Xi said China-Russia ties stand "as firm as a mountain". Putin said what the world needs is "unity rather than division" and "dialogue rather than ultimatums".
🔹 Xi called for more cooperation on AI and free trade and said China would lower tariffs. Putin said Western sanctions have failed to stop Russia's economy.
🔹 The three-way talks with Trump are set for Thursday. The White House says nuclear weapons and the Iran war will be discussed, and Trump says Ukraine will be too.

💬 What should Xi, Putin and Trump agree on first? 👇

Sources: AFP, TASS, ANI

photo_needed: Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin together (shaking hands or at talks), faces clearly visible. A big, clear, landscape photo works best.

headline: [Rare Welcome!] Xi Jinping Greets Trump on the Tarmac in [Shenzhen]
sub: Three-way talks with Putin set for Thursday
caption:
🚨 BREAKING: Rare Welcome! Xi Jinping Greets Trump on the Tarmac in Shenzhen

US President Donald Trump landed in Shenzhen, China, on Wednesday, November 18, for the APEC summit. Chinese President Xi Jinping met him on the tarmac as he stepped off Air Force One. The two leaders shook hands and hugged, then walked a red carpet to their cars.

🔹 It is a rare move. The BBC reported it is believed to be the first time Xi, as president, has welcomed a foreign leader at the airport. Xi did not greet Russian President Vladimir Putin, who arrived earlier the same day.
🔹 Trump came from the Philippines, where he met President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. In September, Trump personally welcomed Xi at Joint Base Andrews near Washington.
🔹 On Thursday, Trump, Xi and Putin are set to hold their first-ever three-way meeting, plus a separate Trump-Xi meeting. Nuclear weapons and the war in Ukraine are expected to be discussed.

💬 What do you hope comes out of the Trump-Xi-Putin talks? 👇

Sources: NPR, Forbes, BBC, Euronews

headline: [Gulf Escalation!] Iran Fires Drones at US Base in [Kuwait] and Bahrain
sub: Both countries say attacks were intercepted
caption:
⚠️ Gulf Escalation! Iran Fires Drones at US Base in Kuwait and at Bahrain

Iran launched drone and air attacks on Kuwait and Bahrain early on Wednesday, November 18. Both countries said their air defences intercepted the attacks. Iran said it was responding to a US strike on Iran's Qeshm Island on Tuesday.

🔹 Iran's military said it targeted US Patriot air defence systems and drone and missile launchers at Kuwait's Ali Al Salem Air Base, which hosts US forces. No casualties or damage were reported.
🔹 Kuwait's foreign ministry called the attacks a "dangerous escalation". Bahrain, home to the US Navy's Fifth Fleet, accused Iran of a "systematic hostile approach".
🔹 Iran's army chief, Amir Hatami, warned that any new US attack would get a "more crushing" response. Qatar said it will hold new talks with Iran.

💬 Can Gulf countries and Iran find a way to calm things down? 👇

Sources: Reuters, AP, The National

headline: [Face to Face!] Trump and Putin Shake Hands in China, First Time Since [Alaska]
sub: Three-way talks with Xi set for Thursday
caption:
🤝 Face to Face! Trump and Putin Shake Hands in China, First Time Since Alaska

US President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin shook hands and exchanged greetings in Shenzhen, China, on Wednesday, November 18, at the APEC summit. It was their first in-person meeting since their Alaska summit in August 2025.

🔹 The two leaders greeted each other before a reception hosted by China's President Xi Jinping. Putin had earlier held talks with Xi.
🔹 On Thursday, Trump, Xi and Putin are set to hold the first-ever three-way meeting of the US, China and Russia.
🔹 Trump said Ukraine will be on the agenda. Ukraine's President Zelensky has raised concerns about plans being discussed without Kyiv or Europe at the table.

💬 What do you hope comes out of Thursday's three-way meeting? 👇

Sources: BBC, AFP, CNN
